# MODEL 5B — DAILY SAFE MOMENTUM
## Beginner-Focused Consistent Daily Trading Model

**Version:** 1.0  
**Year:** 2026  
**Audience:** Beginner Traders / Small Capital Traders  
**Status:** ACTIVE DESIGN DOCUMENT

---

# 1. Overview

Model 5B is a conservative momentum continuation model designed specifically for beginner traders with small capital.

Unlike aggressive breakout or reversal systems, Model 5B prioritizes:

- consistency over large profit
- capital preservation
- emotional stability
- low-complexity decision making
- safe participation in existing trends

This model is intentionally selective and avoids euphoric market conditions.

---

# 2. Core Philosophy

> “Wait for clean, obvious, healthy continuation setups.”

The system does NOT attempt to:
- catch bottoms
- predict reversals
- chase explosive pumps
- scalp aggressively
- trade every market condition

Instead, the system only trades:
- healthy market environments
- strong liquid coins
- controlled pullbacks
- safe momentum continuation

---

# 5. Market Environment Filter (GLOBAL SAFETY GATE)

Trading is ONLY allowed when the overall crypto market is healthy.

## BTC Market Filter

All conditions MUST pass.

| Condition | Rule |
|---|---|
| BTC Daily Trend | BTC close > EMA50 |
| BTC EMA Structure | EMA50 > EMA200 |
| BTC RSI | RSI 50–68 |
| BTC Candle Condition | No large bearish daily candle |
| BTC Volatility | Not extreme |
| BTC 4H Structure | Bullish or neutral |

If ANY condition fails:

```text
NO TRADE TODAY
```

---

# 6. Coin Universe

Model 5B intentionally trades only highly liquid major coins.

## Allowed Coin Criteria

| Parameter | Specification |
|---|---|
| Market Cap Rank | Top 20–30 |
| Liquidity | High |
| Exchange Volume | Strong |
| Spread | Tight |
| Trading Pair | IDR preferred |

## Preferred Coins

- BTC
- ETH
- SOL
- BNB
- XRP

## Excluded Assets

- Memecoins
- Illiquid altcoins
- Newly listed coins
- Low-volume assets
- Extreme pump coins

# 7. Timeframes

| Component | Timeframe |
|---|---|

| Entry Timing | 1H |

---

# 8. Trend Validation

## EMA Trend Alignment

Required:

```text
close > EMA20 > EMA50
```

Preferred:

```text
EMA50 > EMA200
```

## RSI Momentum Zone

Required:

```text
RSI 55–65
```

## MACD Confirmation

Required:

```text
MACD > Signal > 0
```

Additional requirements:
- histogram positive
- histogram not excessively expanded

---

# 9. Pullback Entry Filter

The system NEVER buys large breakout candles.

## Pullback Requirements

| Condition | Rule |
|---|---|
| Pullback Depth | 1–3% |
| Pullback Duration | 1–3 candles |
| Pullback Volume | Lower than breakout volume |
| Pullback Area | Near EMA20 preferred |
| Candle Structure | Small red candle preferred |

## Entry Trigger

Entry becomes valid when:
- pullback stabilizes
- bullish candle closes
- price reclaims short-term momentum

---

# 10. Anti-Euphoria Filter

Reject signal if ANY condition true:

| Condition | Reject Rule |
|---|---|
| 24H Gain Too Large | >15% |
| RSI Overbought | RSI > 70 |
| Huge Candle Expansion | TRUE |
| Funding Extremely Positive | TRUE |
| Volume Explosion | Abnormal |
| Vertical Price Move | TRUE |

---

# 11. Scoring System

| Component | Weight |
|---|---|
| BTC Market Safety | 25 |
| EMA Alignment | 25 |
| RSI Health | 15 |
| MACD Confirmation | 15 |
| Pullback Quality | 15 |
| Liquidity Quality | 5 |

---

# 12. Confidence Rating

| Score | Grade | Action |
|---|---|---|
| 85–100 | A | Preferred |
| 75–84 | B | Allowed |
| 65–74 | C | Optional |
| <65 | Ignore |

Trade ONLY A and B setups.

---

# 13. Exit Rules

## Take Profit

Suggested target:

```text
+1% to +3%
```

## Early Exit Conditions

Exit immediately if:
- BTC weakens significantly
- price closes below EMA20
- momentum weakens
- bearish reversal candle forms

## Stop Loss

Suggested:
- below pullback low
- below EMA20 structure

---

# 14. Risk Management

| Rule | Value |
|---|---|
| Max Active Position | 1 |
| Max Trades Per Day | 1–2 |
| Position Type | Spot only |
| Leverage | Forbidden |

The system should NOT:
- martingale
- revenge trade
- average down losses
- pyramid aggressively
